title: The last Swords goes to the opposing commander
briefing: Held out for `commanderValue` (written before the fix was tuned, never tuned against). P1's only removal is Swords to Plowshares. P2's commander Talrand, Sky Summoner (a 2/2 that makes a 2/2 flying Drake for every instant or sorcery P2 casts) faces P3's Kalonian Tusker, a vanilla 3/3. On power and toughness alone the Tusker is the bigger target.

reference.analysis: Talrand is P2's commander and engine: every instant or sorcery P2 casts adds a 2/2 flier, and P2 has four Islands and a card in hand. Kalonian Tusker is a vanilla 3/3 that threatens nothing a blocker cannot handle. Exiling Talrand sends it to the command zone, so P2 must pay {2} more to recast it. Nobody threatens lethal, so the last answer is best spent on the commander.

options.label: Swords to Plowshares on Talrand
options.why: Removes the engine the opposing deck is built around and taxes its return.

options.label: Swords to Plowshares on Kalonian Tusker
options.why: Spends the last answer on a vanilla body and leaves the commander's engine running.

options.label: Pass and keep Swords
options.why: Holds the answer while Talrand starts making fliers on P2's turn.

otherwise.why: Spends the turn on something else while Talrand stays.
